public RecursiveCachingIterator::__construct Iteratoriterator intflagsRecursiveCachingIterator::CALL_TOSTRING
Constructs a new RecursiveCachingIterator, which consists of a passed in iterator.
Whether the current element has children is checked when the iterator moves to it. If it does, its children are wrapped in a new RecursiveCachingIterator created with the same flags, which RecursiveCachingIterator::getChildren returns.

&reftitle.parameters;
iterator
The iterator being used. It must be a RecursiveIterator.
flags
A bitmask of the CachingIterator constants, as for CachingIterator::__construct.
With CachingIterator::CATCH_GET_CHILD, an exception thrown by the RecursiveIterator::hasChildren or RecursiveIterator::getChildren method of the inner iterator is discarded, and the current element is treated as having no children.
